property_summary: After calling SetMinSum(100) before initialization, then Initialized(), then Collect(0) with a fresh account, the reference sets MinSum to 100 while the buggy version (where SetMinSum reverts if !initialized) leaves MinSum at 0.
change_summary: Replace 'if(intitalized)revert();' with 'if(!intitalized)revert();' so MinSum can only be set before initialization.
